meta.en: Era: Studied from the famine of 1884–85; active from about 1890 into the late 1920s
meta.sw: Kipindi: Alisoma tangu njaa ya 1884–85; alifanya kazi yake kuanzia karibu 1890 hadi mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1920
meta.dg: Wakati: Wasoma kula ndzala ya 1884–85; wahenda kaziye kula kama mwaka 1890 hadi mwisho wa miaka ya 1920

meta.en: Role: One of the first Digo to study the Qur'an formally and come home to teach; first Imam of the Pungu Tuliani Mosque; healer; litigant in the 1928 Digo inheritance case
meta.sw: Jukumu: Mmoja wa Wadigo wa kwanza kusoma Qurani kwa utaratibu na kurudi nyumbani kufundisha; Imamu wa kwanza wa Msikiti wa Tuliani wa Pungu; mganga; mdai katika kesi ya mirathi ya Wadigo ya 1928
meta.dg: Kazi: Mmwenga wa Adigo a kpwandza kusoma Kuruani kpwa utaratibu na kuuya kaya kufundza; Imamu wa kpwandza wa Msikiti wa Tuliani wa Pungu; mgbwanga; walumba kesi ya urisi ya Adigo ya 1928

meta.en: Region: Pungu, south of Likoni, Kwale, present-day Kenya
meta.sw: Eneo: Pungu, kusini mwa Likoni, Kwale, Kenya ya leo
meta.dg: Phatu: Pungu, kusini ya Likoni, Kwale, Kenya ya rero

blocks.en: In the second half of the 19th century the first Digo Muslims had almost nowhere at home to learn their faith. There were no Qur'an schools in Digo villages, and converts went to Mombasa to pray. Ali bin Muhammad Mwaganyuma of Pungu helped to change that. He went away to study, came home, preached in the market while people jeered at him, and kept teaching. His neighbours came to call him simply Mwalimu Ali, "Ali the teacher".
blocks.sw: Katika nusu ya pili ya karne ya 19, Waislamu wa kwanza wa Kidigo hawakuwa na mahali popote karibu nyumbani pa kujifunza dini yao. Hapakuwa na vyuo vya Qurani katika vijiji vya Wadigo, na waliosilimu walikwenda Mombasa kuswali. Ali bin Muhammad Mwaganyuma wa Pungu alisaidia kubadilisha hali hiyo. Alikwenda mbali kusoma, akarudi nyumbani, akahubiri sokoni huku watu wakimzomea, na akaendelea kufundisha. Majirani zake wakaja kumwita kwa urahisi Mwalimu Ali, yaani "Ali mwalimu".
blocks.dg: Kpwenye nusu ya phiri ya karne ya 19, kpwa Aislamu a kpwandza a Chidigo kala ni vigumu kuphaha phatu phephi na kaya pha kudzifundza dini yao. Kala takuna shule za Kuruani kpwenye vidzidzi vya Adigo, na ariosilimu kala anaphiya Mombasa kuswali. Ali bin Muhammad Mwaganyuma wa Pungu waterya kubadilisha hali iyo. Waphiya kure kusoma, achiuya kaya, achihubiri cheteni kuno atu anamfyola, na achienderera kufundza. Majiranige achiandza kumuiha Mwalimu Ali bahi, manaye "Ali mwalimu".

blocks.en: His story comes chiefly from the historian David Sperling, who interviewed Mwalimu Ali's grandsons in the 1980s and traced the family in colonial records.
blocks.sw: Habari zake zinatoka hasa kwa mwanahistoria David Sperling, aliyewahoji wajukuu wa Mwalimu Ali katika miaka ya 1980 na kuifuatilia familia hiyo katika kumbukumbu za kikoloni.
blocks.dg: Habarize nyinji hunaziphaha kula kpwa mwanahistoria David Sperling, ariyeauza maswali adzukulu a Mwalimu Ali kpwenye miaka ya 1980, na achiilunga mbari iyo kpwenye kumbukumbu za chikoloni.

blocks.en: Pungu lay near the ferry to Mombasa and was home to Ngare's market, the largest Digo market south of the town, which Baluchi traders frequented.
blocks.sw: Pungu ilikuwa karibu na kivuko cha kwenda Mombasa, na hapo ndipo palikuwa soko la Ngare, soko kubwa kuliko yote la Wadigo kusini mwa mji huo, lililotembelewa mara kwa mara na wafanyabiashara wa Kibaluchi.
blocks.dg: Pungu kala i phephi na chivuko cha kuvukira Mombasa, na iko kala kuna *chete cha Ngare*, chete chikulu kuriko vyosi vya Adigo kusini ya mji uho, ambacho achuuzi a Chibaluchi kala anachiphiya chila mara.

blocks.en: Ali's grandfather, Ali Ganyuma Mwanrudzu, was the *mwanatsi* of Kaya Similani. A kaya was a Digo fortified settlement governed by a council of elders (*ngambi*), and the mwanatsi ("son of the land") was its senior elder, chosen through the mother's line. He had inherited the post from his maternal uncle. Traders had to ask his permission to do business at Pungu. Through them, and through clan relatives already Muslim at Mtongwe, he became a Muslim, perhaps as early as the 1850s, and took the name Ali. He died in about 1865. He was one of the few converts of his time to raise his children as Muslims, telling them, as his great-great-grandson remembered: "If you don't pray, you don't eat." But there was no school for them, and his eldest son, Muhammad Mwaganyuma, is said to have learned something on his own.
blocks.sw: Babu yake Ali, Ali Ganyuma Mwanrudzu, alikuwa *mwanatsi* wa Kaya Similani. Kaya ilikuwa makazi ya Wadigo yaliyozungushiwa ulinzi na kutawaliwa na baraza la wazee (*ngambi*), na mwanatsi ("mwana wa nchi") alikuwa mzee wake mkuu, aliyechaguliwa kwa kufuata ukoo wa mama. Yeye alirithi cheo hicho kutoka kwa mjomba wake. Wafanyabiashara walilazimika kumwomba ruhusa ili kufanya biashara Pungu. Kupitia kwao, na kupitia jamaa wa ukoo wake waliokuwa tayari Waislamu huko Mtongwe, alisilimu, pengine mapema kama miaka ya 1850, akachukua jina Ali. Alifariki karibu mwaka 1865. Alikuwa mmoja wa waliosilimu wachache wa wakati wake waliowalea watoto wao kama Waislamu, akiwaambia, kama kitukuu chake kimoja kilivyokumbuka: "Usiposwali, huli." Lakini hapakuwa na chuo cha kuwafundishia, na inasemekana mwanawe wa kwanza, Muhammad Mwaganyuma, alijifunza kidogo peke yake.
blocks.dg: Tsaweye Ali, Ali Ganyuma Mwanrudzu, kala ni *mwanatsi* wa Kaya Similani. Kaya kala ni mudzi wa Adigo uriorindwa na kulongozwa ni *ngambi* (baraza ra azehe), na mwanatsi ("mwana wa tsi") kala ni mzehe mkpwulu wa kaya iyo, ariyetsambulwa kpwa kulunga uphande wa mayo. Iye warisi cheo hicho kula kpwa aphuye. Achuuzi kala analazimika kumvoya ruhusa ya kuhenda biashara Pungu. Kpwa njira ya achuuzi hinyo, na kpwa njira ya achina a mbariye ariokala tayari ni Aislamu iko Mtongwe, iye wasilimu, chahi hata kare dza miaka ya 1850, achihala dzina Ali. Wafwa kama mwaka 1865. Kala ni mmwenga wa ariosilimu achache a wakati uho ariorera ana ao dza Aislamu, achiaambira, dza mdzukulu wa mdzukuluwe arivyotambukira: "Usiphoswali, kundarya." Ela kala takuna shule ya kuafundzira, na nkugombwa kukala mwanawe wa kpwandza, Muhammad Mwaganyuma, wadzifundza chidide macheye.

blocks.en: During the Mwakisenge famine of 1884–85, Muhammad sent his son Ali to stay with an uncle, Mwinyihamisi Mwandungo, a Digo trader who had settled at Mtanganyiko in the 1870s. Mtanganyiko, north of Mombasa, was then the main centre of Islam among the northern Mijikenda. There Ali studied at the Qur'an school under Omari Ngoma and also under Muhammad bin Ali Mazrui. He also learned *falaki*, a kind of astrology that claimed to influence events as well as read them.
blocks.sw: Wakati wa njaa ya Mwakisenge ya 1884–85, Muhammad alimpeleka mwanawe Ali kukaa na mjomba wake, Mwinyihamisi Mwandungo, mfanyabiashara Mdigo aliyekuwa amehamia Mtanganyiko katika miaka ya 1870. Mtanganyiko, kaskazini mwa Mombasa, wakati huo ndio ulikuwa kitovu kikuu cha Uislamu miongoni mwa Mijikenda wa kaskazini. Huko Ali alisoma katika chuo cha Qurani chini ya Omari Ngoma, na pia chini ya Muhammad bin Ali Mazrui. Alijifunza pia *falaki*, aina ya unajimu iliyodaiwa kuweza kuathiri matukio pamoja na kuyabashiri.
blocks.dg: Wakati wa ndzala ya Mwakisenge ya 1884–85, Muhammad wamuhuma mwanawe Ali akasagale na aphuye, Mwinyihamisi Mwandungo, mchuuzi Mdigo ariyekala akasagala Mtanganyiko tangu miaka ya 1870. Mtanganyiko, kaskazini ya Mombasa, wakati uho kala ndipho phatu phakulu pha Uislamu kahi za Amijikenda a kaskazini. Iko Ali wasoma chuwo cha Kuruani kpwa mwalimu Omari Ngoma, na piya kpwa Muhammad bin Ali Mazrui. Wadzifundza piya *falaki*, aina ya kulola nyota ambayo kala inagombwa kukala inaweza kubadilisha mambo, si kugamanya kabla gadzangbwefika bahi.

blocks.en: Back home, Ali went with his father to Ngare's market and preached Islam there. In Sperling's words, "popular reaction was hostile ('he was jeered and shouted down') but this does not seem to have deterred him." He went on preaching, began to teach the children of Digo converts, and became known as Mwalimu Ali. People also came to him for treatment, and he went about treating them.
blocks.sw: Aliporudi nyumbani, Ali alikwenda na baba yake katika soko la Ngare na kuhubiri Uislamu huko. Kwa maneno ya Sperling, "watu walipinga kwa uhasama ('alizomewa na kunyamazishwa kwa kelele') lakini jambo hilo halionekani kumkatisha tamaa". Aliendelea kuhubiri, akaanza kuwafundisha watoto wa Wadigo waliosilimu, na akajulikana kama Mwalimu Ali. Watu pia walimjia kutibiwa, naye alizunguka akiwatibu.
blocks.dg: Ariphouya kaya, Ali waphiya na ise chete cha Ngare achihubiri Uislamu phapho. Kpwa maneno ga Sperling, "atu amrema kpwa ukali ('amfyola na achimnyamazisha kpwa kululu') ela taionekana kukala dzambo riro ramzuwiya". Waenderera kuhubiri, achiandza kufundza ana a Adigo ariosilimu, achimanyikana dza Mwalimu Ali. Atu piya kala anakpwedza kpwakpwe kuphozwa, naye kala anazunguluka achiaphoza.

blocks.en: In the 1890s his father and Hamisi Mwapodzo built the first mosques of Pungu, the Pungu Tuliani Mosque and the Chingbwede Mosque. Mwalimu Ali became the first Imam of the Pungu Mosque. His pupil Saidi bin Hamisi Mwapodzo later built the first mosque at Matuga. Sperling notes that Saidi, unlike "his teacher Mwalimu Ali", did not condemn Digo customs but joined in Digo dances to win acceptance.
blocks.sw: Katika miaka ya 1890 baba yake na Hamisi Mwapodzo walijenga misikiti ya kwanza ya Pungu, yaani Msikiti wa Tuliani wa Pungu na Msikiti wa Chingbwede. Mwalimu Ali akawa Imamu wa kwanza wa Msikiti wa Pungu. Mwanafunzi wake Saidi bin Hamisi Mwapodzo baadaye alijenga msikiti wa kwanza wa Matuga. Sperling anaeleza kwamba Saidi, tofauti na "mwalimu wake Mwalimu Ali", hakuzilaani mila za Wadigo bali alijiunga katika ngoma za Kidigo ili akubalike.
blocks.dg: Kpwenye miaka ya 1890 ise na Hamisi Mwapodzo adzenga misikiti ya kpwandza ya Pungu, nayo ni Msikiti wa Tuliani wa Pungu na Msikiti wa Chingbwede. Mwalimu Ali achikala Imamu wa kpwandza wa Msikiti wa Pungu. Mwanafundziwe Saidi bin Hamisi Mwapodzo badaye wadzenga msikiti wa kpwandza wa Matuga. Sperling anaandika kukala Saidi, tafwauti na "mwalimuwe Mwalimu Ali", kayazilaumu mila za Adigo, ela wadziunga na ngoma za Chidigo ili akubalike.

blocks.en: Mwalimu Ali was also a man of business. A 1913 list of traders at Pungu includes an "Ali bin Mohamed selling calico and American cloths", probably him, and his grandson said he traded in rubber. In 1914–15 he and his father were among the Digo leaders who applied for land titles.
blocks.sw: Mwalimu Ali pia alikuwa mfanyabiashara. Orodha ya wafanyabiashara wa Pungu ya mwaka 1913 ina jina la "Ali bin Mohamed anayeuza kaniki na vitambaa vya Kimarekani", pengine yeye mwenyewe, na mjukuu wake alisema alifanya biashara ya mpira. Mwaka 1914–15 yeye na baba yake walikuwa miongoni mwa viongozi wa Kidigo walioomba hati za ardhi.
blocks.dg: Mwalimu Ali piya kala ni mchuuzi. Orodha ya achuuzi a Pungu ya mwaka 1913 ina dzina ra "Ali bin Mohamed anayeguza kaniki na nguwo za Chimarekani", chahi ni iye, na mdzukuluwe wagomba kukala kala anahenda biashara ya mpira. Mwaka 1914–15 iye na ise kala ni kahi za vilongozi a Chidigo ariovoya hati za tsi.

blocks.en: His most far-reaching act came in the 1920s. Muhammad Mwaganyuma is said to have died in about 1922. Under Digo custom, property passed through the mother's line, and his brother, also named Ali Ganyuma, claimed the estate. Mwalimu Ali refused. As his grandson told it, he said to his uncle: "You have your sons, and Mwaganyuma had his son, who is me. You can't take my father's property."
blocks.sw: Kitendo chake chenye athari kubwa zaidi kilikuja katika miaka ya 1920. Inasemekana Muhammad Mwaganyuma alifariki karibu mwaka 1922. Kwa mila ya Wadigo, mali ilirithiwa kwa kufuata ukoo wa mama, na ndugu yake, aliyeitwa pia Ali Ganyuma, akadai urithi wake. Mwalimu Ali alikataa. Kama mjukuu wake alivyosimulia, alimwambia ami yake: "Wewe una wana wako, na Mwaganyuma alikuwa na mwanawe, ambaye ni mimi. Huwezi kuchukua mali ya baba yangu."
blocks.dg: Dzambo kulu kuriko gosi arirohenda rakpwedza kpwenye miaka ya 1920. Nkugombwa kukala Muhammad Mwaganyuma wafwa kama mwaka 1922. Kpwa mila za Adigo, mali kala zinarisiwa kpwa uphande wa mayo, na nduguye, ambaye naye kala anaihwa Ali Ganyuma, achidai urisiwe. Mwalimu Ali warema. Dza mdzukuluwe arivyosimulia, wamuambira ise mdide: "Uwe una anao a chilume, na Mwaganyuma kala ana mwanawe, ambaye ni mimi. Kuweza kuhala mali za baba yangu."

blocks.en: The elders' council and the court at Kwale decided for the uncle by Digo custom. Mwalimu Ali, helped by his son Shaykh Mwinyi, who had studied some Islamic law, took the case to the Supreme Court of Kenya, which found for him. The uncle then appealed to the Court of Appeal for Eastern Africa, sitting at Kampala. In March 1928 it dismissed the appeal in *Ali Ganyuma v. Ali Mohamed*, ruling that "Mohammedan Law applies and the estate descends patrilineally."
blocks.sw: Baraza la wazee na mahakama ya Kwale zilimpa ushindi ami yake kwa kufuata mila ya Wadigo. Mwalimu Ali, akisaidiwa na mwanawe Shaykh Mwinyi, aliyekuwa amesoma sheria ya Kiislamu kiasi, alipeleka kesi hiyo katika Mahakama Kuu ya Kenya, nayo ikaamua kwa niaba yake. Kisha ami yake akakata rufaa katika Mahakama ya Rufaa ya Afrika Mashariki, iliyokuwa ikiketi Kampala. Mnamo Machi 1928 mahakama hiyo ilitupilia mbali rufaa hiyo katika kesi ya *Ali Ganyuma v. Ali Mohamed*, ikiamua kwamba "Sheria ya Kiislamu ndiyo inayotumika na mali inarithiwa kwa kufuata ukoo wa baba".
blocks.dg: Ngambi ya azehe na koti ya Kwale zamuamulira ndugu wa ise kpwa kulunga mila za Adigo. Mwalimu Ali, phamwenga na mwanawe Shaykh Mwinyi, ariyekala akasoma chidide shariya ya Chiislamu, waihala kesi iyo achiiphirika Koti Kulu ya Kenya, nayo ichimuamulira iye. Chisha ise mdide achikata rufaa kpwenye Koti ya Rufaa ya Afrika ya Mashariki, iriyokala inasagala Kampala. Mwezi wa Machi 1928 koti iyo yairema rufaa iyo kpwenye kesi ya *Ali Ganyuma v. Ali Mohamed*, ichiamula kukala "Shariya ya Chiislamu ndiyo inahumika, na mali zinarisiwa kpwa uphande wa baba".

blocks.en: The ruling divided the Digo. That same year the Local Native Council, the elders' body for the district, asked the government to let Digo custom apply unless a man had left a will. In 1929 the District Commissioner reported that people wanted "to evolve a system of patrilineal inheritance, rather than that the old custom should be done away with by the 'stroke of a pen'". Sperling judges that Mwalimu Ali "persisted in his legal appeal out of religious conviction".
blocks.sw: Uamuzi huo uliwagawa Wadigo. Mwaka huo huo Baraza la Wenyeji la Eneo, chombo cha wazee cha wilaya, liliomba serikali iruhusu mila ya Wadigo itumike isipokuwa pale mtu alipoacha wasia. Mwaka 1929 Mkuu wa Wilaya aliripoti kwamba watu walitaka "kujenga taratibu mfumo wa kurithi kwa ukoo wa baba, badala ya mila ya zamani kufutwa kwa 'pigo moja la kalamu'". Sperling anahitimisha kwamba Mwalimu Ali "aliendelea na rufaa yake ya kisheria kwa sababu ya imani yake ya kidini".
blocks.dg: Uamuzi uho waaganya Adigo. Mwaka uho uho Baraza ra Enyeji ra Wilaya, baraza ra azehe a wilaya iyo, ravoya serikali iriche mila za Adigo zihumike, ila mutu achifwa akaricha wasiya. Mwaka 1929 Afisa wa Wilaya waandika kukala atu kala anamendza "kudzenga pole-pole njira ya kurisi kpwa uphande wa baba, badala ya mila za kare kurichwa kpwa 'mkpwaruzo mwenga wa kalamu'". Sperling anaona kukala Mwalimu Ali "waenderera na rufaaye ya koti kpwa sababu ya imaniye ya dini".

blocks.en: No date of birth or death has been found for Mwalimu Ali. Most of what is known comes from his grandsons, Uthman and Ngumi bin Shaykh Mwinyi, from scattered colonial lists and from the law report of his case. His son Shaykh Mwinyi later taught at Msambweni and died at Lungalunga in 1947.
blocks.sw: Hakuna tarehe ya kuzaliwa wala ya kufariki kwa Mwalimu Ali iliyopatikana. Mengi yanayojulikana yanatoka kwa wajukuu wake, Uthman na Ngumi bin Shaykh Mwinyi, kwenye orodha za kikoloni zilizotawanyika, na kwenye ripoti ya kisheria ya kesi yake. Mwanawe Shaykh Mwinyi baadaye alifundisha Msambweni na akafariki Lungalunga mwaka 1947.
blocks.dg: Taiphahikana tarehe ya kuvyalwa wala ya kufwa kpwa Mwalimu Ali. Mambo manji ganagomanyikana ganaphahikana kula kpwa adzukulue, Uthman na Ngumi bin Shaykh Mwinyi, kpwa orodha za chikoloni zirizotawanyika, na kpwa ripoti ya koti ya kesiye. Mwanawe Shaykh Mwinyi badaye wafundza Msambweni, achifwa Lungalunga mwaka 1947.

blocks.en: Mwalimu Ali was one of the first Digo to study away from home and return to teach his own people. He put up with ridicule to do it, led Pungu's first congregation and taught converts' children. Through his long lawsuit he settled, for the colonial courts, how a Digo Muslim's property should pass, a question the community argued over for years afterwards.
blocks.sw: Mwalimu Ali alikuwa mmoja wa Wadigo wa kwanza kusoma mbali na nyumbani na kurudi kuwafundisha watu wake. Alivumilia dhihaka ili kufanya hivyo, akaongoza jamaa ya kwanza ya waumini wa Pungu, na akawafundisha watoto wa waliosilimu. Kupitia kesi yake ndefu aliamua, mbele ya mahakama za kikoloni, jinsi mali ya Mdigo Mwislamu inavyopaswa kurithiwa, swali ambalo jamii iliendelea kulijadili kwa miaka mingi baadaye.
blocks.dg: Mwalimu Ali kala ni mmwenga wa Adigo a kpwandza kusoma kure na kaya na kuuya kufundza atue. Wavumirira kufyolwa ili ahende hivyo, achilongoza kundi ra kpwandza ra Aislamu a Pungu, na achifundza ana a ariosilimu. Kpwa kesiye ndefu waamula, mbere za makoti ga chikoloni, vira mali za Mdigo Mwislamu zivyolondwa kurisiwa; atu a jamii aenderera kulumbana kuhusu swali riro kpwa miaka minji badaye.
